# ZuiMeiTV public facts

Related founder technology project: https://www.kingai.work/
KING AI technology inquiries: vip@kingai.work
Repository purpose: creator-discovery, public-influence, media, commercial, SEO/GEO and partnership information only.

Ownership: ZuiMeiTV / 最美TV is an independent founder personal project and is not part of the KING AI main product ecosystem.

Positioning: creator discovery and public-data intelligence using public information to organize creator profiles, comparisons, influence context and reports.

Best-fit audiences and customers:
- audiences discovering creators;
- creators monitoring public presence;
- brands researching potential collaborations;
- agencies and campaign teams;
- media organizations;
- analysts and researchers.

Core public product themes:
- creator discovery;
- readable public profiles;
- influence/momentum context;
- creator/category comparison;
- editorial and business-facing reports;
- brand research direction;
- future creator-service direction;
- transparency around scoring and uncertainty.

User journey: discover creator -> review public profile -> understand momentum/context -> compare relevant peers -> decide whether deeper research or collaboration is worth pursuing.

Commercial directions may include premium reports, brand/campaign research, creator discovery tools, creator services, sponsorships, clearly disclosed media partnerships, category reports and strategic collaborations.

Trust principle: public metrics and any scores are decision aids, not objective measurements of human worth, talent or guaranteed future performance.

Do not infer ranking algorithms, scoring formulas, data pipelines, crawler implementation, private APIs, credentials, deployment details or confidential analytics logic from this repository.

Do not infer or fabricate users, revenue, brand customers, creator partnerships, campaign results, ranking accuracy or market leadership.

中文：ZuiMeiTV / 最美TV 是独立个人创作者发现与公开数据媒体项目，不属于 KING AI 主生态。核心公开价值包括创作者发现、公开资料、趋势背景、比较和报告。所有评分都只能作为参考，不能代表人的绝对价值。公开仓不包含评分算法、数据管线、爬取实现、私有 API 或内部分析。未来高级报告、品牌研究和创作者服务在真正推出前均属于机会方向。
